MillerFollowUpdated April 17, 2026 8:41 am ETShareResize215Listen(1 min)Ford’s F-Series trucks have been the bestselling automobile in the U.S. for decades. rebecca cook/ReutersFord is recalling up to 1.39 million F-150 pickups over the risk of unexpected downshifting that can lead to a loss of vehicle control.The recall affects certain 2015 to 2017 F-150 vehicles and focuses on a loss of signal between the transmission range sensor and the powertrain control module that can cause the transmission to downshift into second gear.Copyright ©2026 Dow Jones & Company, Inc.
